messages.subject: Kingsgate House – contract mark-up (our amendments)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Martin,

Our marked-up contract is attached (redline against your draft). The principal amendments are:

1. Completion period reduced to 15 working days from exchange (we've pencilled 15 May).
2. Clause 8 (insurance): the Seller to keep the Property insured to full reinstatement value until completion, with risk remaining with the Seller until completion – please reinstate Condition 7.1.
3. Clause 6 (tenancies): no new lettings, variations or surrenders between exchange and completion without our client's consent, and rents to be collected in the ordinary course (not commuted or paid in advance).

Grateful for your client's agreement to these. Most are standard buyer protections.

messages.subject: RE: Kingsgate House – contract mark-up (our amendments)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Thank you for the mark-up. Our client agrees to points 1 and 3. On point 2 (insurance), our client is content for risk to remain with the Seller until completion and will maintain its existing block policy; please confirm you do not require a separate noting of interest. Subject to that, I think we are agreed on the contract and can move to engrossments.

Kind regards,
Martin
